headline: Fuel prices hit new records: oil reaches 229 lekë, petrol 219 lekë per liter / Is supply at risk?!
summary: Domestic oil and petrol prices in Albania are approaching record levels recorded during the war in Ukraine, with oil at 229 lekë and petrol at 219 lekë per litre.
why: Fuel prices feed directly into transport costs and inflation, and Albania imports most of its refined fuel.

backfill_provenance.description_from: publisher page metadata, translated to English by Claude

original_headline: Nafta kap rekorde të reja, arrin 229 lekë, benzina 219 lekë për litër/ A rrezikohet furnizimi?!
